title: V-8 "454" ENGINE H.D.-IGNITION SYSTEM WIRING & COIL
summary: RPO LS7 454 heavy-duty V-8 ignition: the ignition coil on the engine next to the distributor, an ignition amplifier (transistor ignition amplifier) bolted to the LH front inner fender/wheelhouse, and the harness running along the fender from the amplifier to the coil and engine harness. The amplifier is held by a bolt from the front and a nut with lock washer; a production screw holds the black ground strap. The engine harness positive coil lead gets a new terminal plugged into a connector, and a wire is added to the ignition switch connector.

parts.name: HARNESS ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Harness assembly – ignition amplifier to coil/engine harness

fastening.note: Bolt [9] goes through the amplifier [8] flange and panel; lock washer [7] and nut [6] on the other side (triangle 1 at the nut).
Coil [4] in its bracket/clamp, production fasteners; coil terminal nuts at triangle 2 ('COIL'). Black lead to the negative (-) post, white to the positive (+) post.

fastening.to: along the fender skirt to the amplifier [8]
fastening.note: Harness [5] runs from the amplifier along the wheelhouse and through a grommet (see UPC 12) to the coil and engine harness; black ground strap held by a production screw at the amplifier.
Tape [1]: 5 inches used to tape the red-white and black positive coil wire to the engine wiring harness (note A).
View A: terminal [10] crimped to the yellow wire and inserted into connector [2].
Wire [3] terminal inserted in the ignition switch connector cavity; 12 ga pink wire removed from that connector.
